more generally, for coherent analytic sheaves with operators A and B, Ext^i_{O,G}(X;A,B) is finite-dimensional for every i

current_positive_labels.verdict: coherent extensions on locally Noetherian algebraic stacks, not compact analytic finiteness

missing_inputs: finite-dimensional coherent analytic cohomology on a compact complex analytic space
coherence of ordinary analytic sheaf Ext in every fixed degree
the combined compact-quotient equivariant Ext and bundle-extension finiteness conclusion

candidate.placement: immediately after the D1019 quotient-coherence lemma and before the following constant-sheaf spectral-sequence lemma

proof_obligations.claim: Compact coherent analytic cohomology is finite-dimensional in every degree.
proof_obligations.closure: Apply Grauert proper direct image to Y→point; coherent modules on the analytic point are finite-dimensional complex vector spaces.

proof_obligations.claim: Ordinary internal sheaf Ext of coherent analytic modules is coherent in every fixed degree.
proof_obligations.closure: Construct an arbitrarily long local finite-free partial resolution using coherent syzygies; compute fixed-degree Ext and use the abelian category of coherent modules. No finite projective dimension is claimed.

proof_obligations.claim: Equivariant sheaf Ext is the invariant direct image of ordinary sheaf Ext in characteristic zero for the discontinuous action.
proof_obligations.closure: The ordinary sheaf-Ext stalks are complex vector spaces, so higher stabilizer cohomology and higher invariant direct image vanish; the existing sheaf-Ext spectral sequence collapses.

proof_obligations.claim: Every sheaf on the E2 page of spectral sequence I is coherent on Y.
proof_obligations.closure: P2 and P3 reduce it to invariant direct image of a coherent analytic G-module; D1019 proves that direct image coherent.

proof_obligations.claim: Every global equivariant Ext group is finite-dimensional.
proof_obligations.closure: P1 makes the E2 terms finite-dimensional; the first-quadrant spectral sequence has finitely many terms per total degree and a finite abutment filtration.

proof_obligations.claim: Bundle extensions with fixed endpoints agree with module Yoneda extensions.
proof_obligations.closure: A module extension has locally free middle term because the locally free quotient splits locally; varying-rank analytic bundle/module full faithfulness reconstructs the equivariant bundle maps and equivalences.

proof_obligations.claim: The canonical H1(Y,q_*^G O(E^vee tensor F)) identification and finiteness follow.
proof_obligations.closure: Use the existing finite-locally-free extension lemma, local bundle/module tensor identification, stabilizer-order quotient comparison, D1019 coherence, and P1.
Compactness is only on Y; no X-compactness, global q properness, G finite/free, Ext vanishing, finite set, moduli, algebraic analogue, or GAGA claim is made.

scope_exclusions: the following abstract algebraic-geometry analogue and its characteristic hypotheses
global finiteness or properness of q
finiteness of the set of extensions rather than finite vector-space dimension
Ext vanishing or finite projective dimension on singular analytic spaces
